## 71a8a5e5d0ee

**Reproduced schedule-contract defect: 2 of 6 cyclic starts omit the one-marker branch from all four demos.** The marker-count schedule is `(2,2,3,1,3,2)`. Starts 4 and 5 yield demo counts `(3,2,2,2)` and `(2,2,2,3)`, contradicting the generator comment and `lesson_identifiable` requirement that demos vary across 1, 2, and 3 markers.

A source-bound 100-per-band production census materialized 300 lessons and found 96 production hook warnings (32%), plus 792 warnings across 1,500 query rotations. It found no named-rival ambiguity, so the finding is specifically missing teaching support rather than an incorrect oracle. A compact exact witness at easy seed `2927668412`, start/sample index `4`, is in `checks/audit/71a8a5e5d0ee/curriculum-witness.json`; the complete report is `checks/audit-71a8a5e5d0ee-lesson-census.json.gz`, mapped in `checks/compressed-evidence-manifest.json`. Generator SHA is `00b6808cb646c891457ca538d3038592642c27fcb71baabc607c3529b448b317`, rule hash `75f502e2e53c`.

I left the audit target unchanged. A repair should change the six-slot marker schedule (or lesson assembly) so every cyclic four-demo window contains counts 1, 2, and 3, then rerun all query rotations.
